name: Ground Control
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach Earth Station: SEA Headquarters, Uprising's Weyland identity, which allows one remote server, makes the Runner pay 1[credit] more to run HQ, flips for a click to make a remote cost 6[credit] to run instead, and flips back when the Runner makes a successful run on HQ — and the Weyland ice of Uprising Stage 8. On Hostile Bid's frame, its identity swapped: three Akhet, a barrier the Corp can advance that grows 3 strength and lets the Runner break only one of its subroutines once it holds 3 counters, and whose first subroutine places a counter on any installed card; and three Winchester, a sentry of traces that trashes a program or a piece of hardware and, protecting HQ, gains a third that ends the run — for its two Hostile Architecture, two Superdeep Borehole and two Svyatogor Excavator, assets that want remotes this identity does not allow. Hostile Bid keeps every card given up here.
